judge.rationale: The candidate only finished the planning/test-writing phase and never implemented the actual fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is completely untouched, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately for all non-Error rejections. The candidate also failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria, and left an agent artifact (`.lore/dod.md`) in the diff. While the update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the structure of the test are reasonable (though testing via `beforeModelResponse` rather than a rejecting provider as requested by the ticket), the core bug remains unfixed.
